$id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name','rating']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 10 && newData.child('name').val().length >= 1 && newData.child('rating').isNumber() && newData.child('rating').val() >= 0 && newData.child('rating').val() <= 4000

$rid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['targetId','reason','at']) && newData.child('targetId').isString() && newData.child('targetId').val().length <= 64 && newData.child('reason').isString() && newData.child('reason').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('at').isNumber() && (!newData.child('targetName').exists() || (newData.child('targetName').isString() && newData.child('targetName').val().length <= 40))
